repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-search
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.search for the search service (catalog name argonaut). people() POSTs a directory query and resolves the response body; search() binds a user KMS key on first use (bindSearchKey, one-flight), stores its URL as searchEncryptionKeyUrl on the device, and POSTs an activity search whose query an outbound payload transform encrypts, while an inbound predicate hands the activities to the conversation plugin's transform for decryption; with includeRemoteClusterReferences it appends activities fetched from remote clusters. It stores nothing itself.

search-internal-sdk.summary: Published npm package (internal plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations are published. Importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-conversation and @webex/internal-plugin-encryption, then registers Search as internal plugin 'search' with config {search: {}} and the payload predicates encryptSearchQuery (outbound) and transformObjectArray (inbound) plus the outbound transform encryptSearchQuery; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default Search class. webex.internal.search exposes people, search, and bindSearchKey; specified in src/docs/README.md.

argonaut-search-http.source: Search service (catalog service name argonaut in src/search.js and src/index.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
argonaut-search-http.summary: POST directory with the caller's options as body ({queryString, ...}), resolving the response body; POST search with the caller's options plus searchEncryptionKeyUrl, query sent as a JWE string, returning body.activities.items (encrypted activities, each with objectType) and optionally body.breadcrumbs {<cluster>: {items: [{activityUrl}]}}.

kms-search-key.source: KMS reached through @webex/internal-plugin-encryption (no SDD spec; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-encryption/src/kms.js, src/encryption.js)
kms-search-key.summary: bindSearchKey calls kms.createUnboundKeys({count: 1}) and kms.createResource({key, userIds: [device.userId]}); the outbound transform calls encryptText(searchEncryptionKeyUrl, query), which resolves a JWE string.

conversation-remote-clusters.source: Remote conversation clusters reached through @webex/internal-plugin-conversation bulkActivitiesFetch (no SDD spec; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-conversation/src/conversation.js)
conversation-remote-clusters.summary: POST bulk_activities_fetch with {activityUrls} at the URL of cluster id <cluster>:identityLookup; the response multistatus is decrypted by the conversation plugin's own inbound predicate and the activities with status 200 are resolved.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerInternalPlugin keys the plugin by its raw name (search, first registration wins) and merges its config into the defaults; WebexPlugin supplies webex, logger, and request, which proxies webex.request.

webex-core-payload-transformer.source: @webex/webex-core payload transformer (module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-008, MOD-037; code consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/webex-core.js, src/interceptors/payload-transformer.js)
webex-core-payload-transformer.summary: Plugin predicates and transforms are concatenated into the default config; the interceptor runs transform('outbound', options) on every request unless noTransform and transform('inbound', response) on every response unless disableTransform; each matching predicate's extracted target goes to every transform of the same name and direction, serially.

webex-core-services.source: @webex/webex-core services plugin (services spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/lib/services/docs/README.md SVC-014, SVC-018, SVC-022)
webex-core-services.summary: ServiceInterceptor maps api to service and joins the catalog URL with the resource; getServiceFromUrl matches a URL to a catalog service; getServiceUrlFromClusterId appends a service name to a short cluster id and throws Could not find service for cluster [<cluster>] when nothing matches.

http-core-request.summary: request moves options.url to options.uri and sets url to null before the interceptor chain runs, so the predicates' url branch never sees a url.
